description: DTU provides students and employees with protected Microsoft Copilot web access using DTU accounts; the DTU version is based on GPT-4 and keeps searches and answers in DTU cloud solutions.
howToObtain: Sign in with a DTU account at copilot.microsoft.com or m365.cloud.microsoft, or use Microsoft Edge.
costToUser: Not specified by the cited DTU source.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: DTU gives access for students and employees to Microsoft Copilot at copilot.microsoft.com or m365.cloud.microsoft when logged into a DTU account. The version made available to DTU students and employees is based on GPT-4 and offers a protected model that keeps searches and answers within DTU's cloud solutions.

description: DTU Library licenses Scite AI, an AI citation and reference service, for access over the DTU network.
howToObtain: Access Scite through the DTU network; creating a user account is optional and unlocks additional features.
costToUser: Not specified by the cited DTU source.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The DTU Library have secured a license for Scite AI and it can be used/accessed via the DTU network. A user account is not required to access the tool, but unlocks additional features.
